Parking Lot B will be closed from Monday, June 3, through Friday, June 14, while the surface is repaved. documents.title: Marlow's Bakery Opens Second Location
documents.text: BRIGHTON (April 12) - Marlow's Bakery, a family-run business known for its sourdough loaves, will open a second location on Harbor Street next month. [A] The new shop will be three times larger than the original on Elm Avenue and will include a café with seating for sixty customers. [B] Owner Helen Marlow said demand had grown steadily since the bakery won a regional food award last year. "We were turning customers away on weekends," she said. [C] To staff the new site, the bakery plans to hire fifteen employees, including four bakers, and will hold a job fair on April 27. [D] The Elm Avenue shop will keep its current hours, while the Harbor Street location will open at 6 a.m. daily.

questions.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
choices: The closing of a family shop
The expansion of a local business
questions.explanation: It reports that the bakery is opening a second, larger location.

questions.prompt: How many employees will the bakery hire?
questions.explanation: The bakery plans to hire fifteen employees, four of them bakers.

questions.explanation: Demand grew steadily means it kept growing at a regular pace.

questions.prompt: In which position marked [A], [B], [C] or [D] does the following sentence best belong? "The larger building will also have a second oven room."
questions.explanation: It follows the sentence describing the size of the new shop, so 'the larger building' refers back to it.

documents.text:
TO: All Sales Staff
FROM: Marcus Bell, Finance Director
DATE: September 9
SUBJECT: Updated Expense Reimbursement Policy

Effective October 1, all travel expense reports must be submitted through the new online portal within ten business days of the end of a trip. Reports submitted late will be paid with the following month's payroll rather than the current one. Receipts are required for any single expense over $25; previously, the limit was $50. Meals will continue to be reimbursed up to $60 per day. Training sessions on the portal will be held on September 18 and 25 in Conference Room 2. Please sign up with your department assistant.

documents.title: Wanted: Event Coordinator
documents.text: Lakeside Hotel in Burnham is seeking a full-time Event Coordinator to plan weddings, conferences, and corporate banquets. Responsibilities include meeting clients, managing vendors, and supervising banquet staff on event days. Requirements: at least three years of experience in event planning, strong communication skills, and availability on weekends. A degree in hospitality is preferred but not required. Salary: $48,000 to $54,000 depending on experience. To apply, send a cover letter and résumé to Ms. Rosa Delgado, Human Resources, by June 20.

documents.title: Event Coordinator position
documents.text:
To: rdelgado@lakesidehotel.example
From: kohara@mailbox.example
Date: June 17

Dear Ms. Delgado,
I am writing to apply for the Event Coordinator position advertised on your website. For the past four years I have organized trade shows and charity dinners at the Harmon Convention Center, where I managed budgets of up to $200,000. I do not hold a degree in hospitality; however, I completed a professional certificate in event management last year. I am available on weekends and could start on August 1. My résumé is attached. I would welcome the chance to discuss my application.
Sincerely,
Kevin O'Hara

documents.title: Re: Event Coordinator position
documents.text:
To: kohara@mailbox.example
From: rdelgado@lakesidehotel.example
Date: June 24

Dear Mr. O'Hara,
Thank you for your application. We would like to invite you for an interview on Tuesday, July 2, at 10 a.m. at the hotel. Please bring two references and examples of events you have planned. Unfortunately, the starting date of August 1 may be difficult, as we need someone to begin by July 15. Please let me know whether that would be possible for you. Also note that the salary will be at the lower end of the range for candidates with fewer than five years of experience.
Best regards,
Rosa Delgado

documents.title: Lovely location, disappointing stay
documents.text:
Maplewood Inn: 2 stars out of 5
Posted by Karen T., March 15

My husband and I stayed three nights at the Maplewood Inn for our anniversary. The view of the lake was beautiful, and the breakfast was excellent. Unfortunately, our room was next to the ice machine, which made noise all night, and the heater was broken on the first evening. It took the front desk almost two hours to send someone to repair it. When I mentioned the problems at check-out, the clerk simply said he was sorry. I would hesitate to return unless the management improves its service.

documents.title: Reply to a guest
documents.text:
Maplewood Inn
12 Lake Road
March 18

Dear Ms. Thompson,
Thank you for taking the time to share your experience. We were very sorry to learn about the problems during your recent stay. The heater has since been replaced in all lakeside rooms, and our staff have been reminded to respond to maintenance requests within thirty minutes. We were not aware that your room was next to the ice machine; we will not assign guests to that room again without notice. To thank you for your patience, we would like to offer you one free night at the inn, valid until December 31. Please call me directly at 555-0178 to book.
Sincerely,
Daniel Moore
General Manager
